args.title: Saltmarsh Foods: Retail Returns Logistics — Newsletter, Article & Companion
args.body:
• Newsletter (Saltmarsh Foods): This week's edition covers retail returns logistics, linking to the blog article and holding a seat for a related webinar.
• Article ("Retail returns logistics"): Apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidating returns into centralized hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth.
• Companion piece: Getting returned items back into resale within 10 days preserved most of the original margin.
